claim: Try it with sample data opens an isolated sample plan and does not save it as your real plan.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real plan, open /demo, then assert the sample plan and persistent demo banner appear instead of real-plan figures.

claim: Shows committed and expected cash for the next 13 weeks.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the sample plan renders 13 selectable forecast weeks and sample schedule items.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for the service worker, reload once, set the context offline, then reload and assert the sample dashboard and offline notice render.

claim: Exports JSON, CSV, and password-encrypted backups.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download each export and inspect the JSON, CSV header/row, and encrypted backup format.

claim: Your financial plan stays in this browser: no bank connection and no tracking.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record all network requests while adding a cash item and assert every request is same-origin.
